title: Extension of a tape prefix
statement: Let $f\colon\mathbb{Z}\to\mathrm{Option}(S)$ be a tape content function, let $a\in\mathbb{Z}$, and let $w$ be a finite word over an alphabet $S$. For a natural number $r<|w|$, changing the tape that contains the prefix of $w$ in cells $a$ through $a+r-1$ so that cell $a+r$ contains the symbol $w_r$ gives exactly the tape that contains the prefix of $w$ in cells $a$ through $a+r$, leaving all other cells as in $f$.
hypotheses_covered: An alphabet $S$ and tape content function $f\colon\mathbb{Z}\to\mathrm{Option}(S)$
